records.name: Japan
records.summary_text: Japan is a very safe destination for transgender visitors in practice, with a legal framework that lags behind. There is no national anti-discrimination law — the 2023 "understanding" law is symbolic — and legal gender change still requires a court process. But courts have moved in trans people's favour: the Supreme Court struck down the sterilisation requirement for legal gender change in 2023 and ruled workplace bathroom restrictions on a transgender woman illegal the same year. If a trans visitor is arrested or detained here, the custody consequence of the lagging framework is documented

records.summary_text:
Thailand is one of Asia's most accepting destinations for transgender visitors. Visible gender variance is part of mainstream culture (the kathoey tradition long predates modern categories), the state actively promotes LGBTQ tourism, same-sex marriage became legal in January 2025 as the first in Southeast Asia, and the Immigration Bureau runs a dedicated "Welcome Pride" initiative to smooth entry for travellers whose passports don't match their appearance or gender.
